desc: 大颗粒原木色块，圆角好抓握，可叠高可平铺一物多玩
leaf: 儿童大颗粒原木彩色拼装积木（长条块与方块混装）
name: 大颗粒原木益智拼搭积木款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是大块原木拼装积木而不是塑料小颗粒，抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏一秒讲清最大购买理由，用大字标题加四个图标位把卖点前置，承接主图点击。
shots.textZone: icon row inside the top #1F3A63 band, headline field in the upper half of the blob window, one support line directly under the headline

shots.intent: 把家长真实烦扰（一碰就塌、漆面磕碰、边角扎手）先放大，再在同一屏给出解决姿态。
shots.textZone: headline strip across the top, one short label centered under each panel

shots.intent: 用微距证明漆面吃进木纹、着色均匀这件事，让质感自己说话，替代源图无法核实的话术。
shots.textZone: one organic blob caption card at the lower left holding a single short label

shots.intent: 把倒角半径与叠放接缝这两个决定手感与稳定性的结构点单独放大，回答好不好抓、稳不稳。
shots.textZone: two thin callout rules leaving the frame edge to their labels on the right side

shots.intent: 让家长代入周末陪玩画面，用真实客厅与手的动作说明玩法与尺度感。
把整套按形状与色别排开，让人一次看清组合丰富度，替买家完成选款与凑单决策。
shots.textZone: one column label above each shape family and one pill label beside the highlighted row

shots.intent: 用真实标尺位与参照物把单块大小和搭完的高度说清，消掉颗粒太大会不会难叠的疑虑。
shots.textZone: dimension rules around the measured block on the left, two short label rows under the anchor at the right

shots.intent: 收掉风险：把到货内容与售后承诺位一次摊开，用实物收纳件与整套装满的画面建立确定感。
shots.textZone: headline above the kit, one row of three icon circles with a short service label under each

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，用成品塔与一个明确的按钮动作把看完的犹豫转成加购。
shots.textZone: clean headline field above the stack, rounded CTA button below the headline inside the blob window

style.backgroundSystem: #FBF3E7 paper fields cut by organic blob windows, one #1F3A63 frame band or panel per screen, at most one #F6C48A flat accent panel; no photographic clutter behind infographic screens
style.direction: playful premium wooden-block ecommerce, picture-book warmth with strict infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: solid #1F3A63 circles with single-weight #FFFFFF line pictograms, numbered circle badges with a #F6C48A star marker, small outline star doodles and dashed guide curves in #7A4A2B; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5500K soft key from the upper left, bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadows under every block, controlled highlights on painted faces, no harsh speculars, no dramatic falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful premium wooden-block ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #1F3A63 frame band, #FBF3E7 paper field and #F6C48A accent panel, with #7A4A2B label ink and one swappable highlight {accent_color}; warm daylight tone; one rounded geometric sans-serif family, heavy rounded display headlines filled #FBF3E7 with a #7A4A2B outline and regular labels at 10-14pt; background system of #FBF3E7 paper fields cut by organic blob windows with one #1F3A63 band and at most one #F6C48A panel per screen; lighting system of a 5500K soft key from the upper left, bounce fill and true contact shadows under every block; surface system of matte #FBF3E7 paper, #EFE6D8 board and #E3CDA8 board; icon system of solid #1F3A63 circles with single-weight #FFFFFF line pictograms, numbered badges and small #7A4A2B star doodles and dashed guides; blocks always rendered true to the reference with stable scale, real paint texture and visible grain, never floating without a contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no handwritten, serif or cartoon lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark
style.presentationRules: block colors and proportions come only from the reference image and never change between screens; the stack keeps the same scale, same corner radius and same paint finish across the set; at least one overhead and one low camera in every set; product never floats without a contact shadow; no identifiable child face in any screen
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FBF3E7 paper sweep for infographic screens, #EFE6D8 board for spec and pain screens, #E3CDA8 board for the living-room play scene; surfaces stay clean, unwrinkled, debris-free
style.typography: one rounded geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy rounded display weight for headlines only (32-48pt, filled #FBF3E7 with a #7A4A2B outline), regular weight for sublines (16-20pt) and labels (10-14pt); all in-image copy rendered only as short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 40 characters
